title: Steel pipes with straps
story: Long steel pipes under four ratchet straps: do they hold in a hard stop?
story_pt: Tubos de aço longos sob quatro cintas com catraca: aguentam uma frenagem forte?

truck.uncertain: only part of the trailer visible; landing gear suggests semi-trailer

units.uncertain: number of pipes, layers and full length not visible; treated as one bundle

wooden pieces/stakes visible near pipes; unclear if they block

analysis.summary: A flatbed semi-trailer carries a stack of large green steel pipes lying lengthwise, secured with at least four yellow/brown top-over straps hooked to the side rail.
